using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.ServiceProxying.CSharp;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.ServiceProxying.CSharp.Tests
{
    public class CSharpServiceProxyGeneratorTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task GenerateProxyAsync_LogsInformationOnFileCreation()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<CSharpServiceProxyGenerator>>();
            var cliHttpClientFactory = new Mock<CliHttpClientFactory>(MockBehavior.Strict);
            var jsonSerializer = new Mock<IJsonSerializer>(MockBehavior.Strict);

            var generator = new CSharpServiceProxyGenerator(cliHttpClientFactory.Object, jsonSerializer.Object);

            // Inject the mock logger via reflection since Logger is protected in base class
            var loggerField = typeof(ServiceProxyGeneratorBase<CSharpServiceProxyGenerator>)
                .GetProperty("Logger", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public);
            if (loggerField == null)
            {
                // fallback to field
                var loggerFieldInfo = typeof(ServiceProxyGeneratorBase<CSharpServiceProxyGenerator>)
                    .GetField("_logger", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic);
                if (loggerFieldInfo != null)
                {
                    loggerFieldInfo.SetValue(generator, mockLogger.Object);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                loggerField.SetValue(generator, mockLogger.Object);
            }

            var args = new GenerateProxyArgs
            {
                WorkDirectory = Path.GetTempPath(),
                Folder = "ClientProxies",
                CommandName = "GenerateProxy",
                WithoutContracts = false
            };

            // Setup minimal ApplicationApiDescriptionModel to trigger the code path
            // We cannot easily mock GetApplicationApiDescriptionModelAsync because it's protected
            // So we will test the RemoveProxyCommand path which calls Logger.LogInformation as well

            // Act
            await generator.GenerateProxyAsync(new GenerateProxyArgs
            {
                WorkDirectory = Path.GetTempPath(),
                Folder = "ClientProxies",
                CommandName = RemoveProxyCommand.Name,
                WithoutContracts = false
            });

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().StartsWith("Delete")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Minimal stubs for dependencies and args
    public class GenerateProxyArgs
    {
        public string WorkDirectory { get; set; }
        public string Folder { get; set; }
        public string CommandName { get; set; }
        public bool WithoutContracts { get; set; }
    }

    public static class RemoveProxyCommand
    {
        public const string Name = "RemoveProxy";
    }

    public interface CliHttpClientFactory { }
    public interface IJsonSerializer { }
}
